title: Quantum Computing Internship for Physics Undergraduates Program (QCIPU)
about: Fermilab's Quantum Computing Internship for Physics Undergraduates (QCIPU) is a three-week programme, June 7-25, 2027, with daily lectures on quantum mechanics and quantum computing, for students at U.S. colleges. Applications run November 3, 2026 to January 14, 2027.
requirements: Enrolled at a U.S. college or university in physics, math, computer science or engineering
Completed one year of introductory physics
Eligible to work in the U.S.
card_alt: Card for the Quantum Computing Internship for Physics Undergraduates Program (QCIPU) at Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory (Fermilab), Batavia, United States, deadline 14 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Statue of Liberty and the Manhattan skyline in New York, not Batavia.
